description: Owner only (your Pro key, never a bot key). Store one login sealed with AES-256-GCM, with a scope: allowed hosts, allowed methods, a daily session cap and session TTL. Run it from your own machine, not inside the bot. The password and TOTP secret are never returned by any tool. Free watch-only stores nothing and logs would_use_vault.

domain.description: Site the login belongs to, e.g. github.com.

scope.description: Where and how this login may be used.

allowed_hosts.description: Hosts the session may call (the login domain is always included; subdomains match). Max 10.

allowed_methods.description: HTTP methods session_fetch may use. Default ["GET","POST"].

bot_label.description: Optional note: which bot this login is for.

max_sessions_per_day.description: Daily cap on open_session for this login, 1-500. Default 20.

totp_secret.description: Optional base32 TOTP secret, so {{totp}} can fill 2FA codes.

name: save_login
